penance.stateWrite: ONE: at decision 105 (10 decisions after the Separation) Penance's HP 8,800,032 -> 30,000 through the debug API; the last blow was Yuna's real Attack (94,016: 'Penance falls', the Right Arm falls with it). A full win is 385 to 487 decisions (30 minutes and more by hand).
notes: Run 1 (penance-run1-arms-first-aborted, kept): a plain 'arms first' line with no schedule lost in 7 decisions (the Left Arm's Tera Graviton then Obliteration wiped the party before the sixth blow), and a second attempt of it survived 47 decisions but only ever dealt 500,000 to Penance (11.5M left) because every turn went to an arm that came back 12 ticks later. Only the turn-list schedule of the handoff's line reached the change: this agrees with the auditors' reading that Penance's winning line needs turn-list-exact play (PR-0635 round 35).

stateWrites.what: Penance HP set to 30,000 after the Separation and 10 decisions of phase 2, so a real Quick Hit (99,999) ends the fight (a full win is 385 to 487 decisions)

notes: Attempts: link 6 lost once (Yojimbo's two Pays rolled plain Wakizashi strokes and Pain killed him; seed 6) then won on the retry (seed 1006, Zanmato on the first Pay after the summon); link 7 lost once (seed 1007: Wakizashi, Wakizashi, Wakizashi) then won on the retry (seed 2007: Zanmato on the first Pay). 24.2 minutes, 3 attempts of the route, 9 link fights.
Round 35's route stalled at link 6 because it had no handler for Yojimbo's Aeon > Pay ladder (PR-0635); this job adds it and it works with real keys.

One finding: on a fodder aeon's turn the card named an Overdrive row (Ixion's Thor's Hammer) that the job's generic opener could not reach, so the aeon was dismissed instead; the HUD row path for an aeon's Overdrive was not mapped (minor, job-side; it did not change the result)
